base: Fully read, already passed tests/support/upl_cubic_component_r2.cpp: Device/transfer helpers, single-cell patch, CSP/CTE constants, actual FS/wall/Darcy wrappers and independent all-particle raw-sum reference
scope: Private zero-step normal-head GPU component only. No JSph object/loading, periodic owner map, actual mechanical force solver, integrator, public admission change or production edit.

good_manufacture.native_pressure: 128+rho_w*gn*x, rho_w=1000. All normal-good physical positions stay strictly within abs(p)<256; the extra tangential gravity never enters p.
good_manufacture.native_Ace: (-gn,0,0); Ace=as-g, so prescribed true acceleration as=(0,0,2)=gt. This is not static mechanical equilibrium.
good_manufacture.velocity_and_effective_stress: Zero; fixed physical velocities stay zero, derived velocity/tangent stay zero, wall theta stays zero.
good_manufacture.expected_wall_pressure: Evaluate the hydrostatic normal head at ACTUAL boundary slot B, not fitted mirror M=B+bn.
good_manufacture.expected_wall_Ace: Q*(Ace+gn)-gn=(-gn,0,0); equivalent to Q*(Ace+g)-g for these axis-plane normals.
good_manufacture.C: Produced by real GPU FS, then real stage1 wall C. Native FS C is byte-unchanged by wall stages; actual conditional C is consumed by the independent rate reference. This fixture does not claim an independent FS-C accuracy oracle.

budgets.state: Original small GPU patch td=32768*DBL_EPSILON*condition, tf=64*FLT_EPSILON*condition; pressure/J/Ace remain256tf/2td/tf. Zero velocity/stress/theta semantics remain exact. Original mirror support determinant check remains.
budgets.physical_face: Independent host positive-weight MLS at q=B+bn/2, using ALL supported fluid and actual fixed-boundary positions/actual J. Pressure/gradient/Ace use retained affine propagation. Flux bound is the CPU gravity manufacture's k/gamma*(tf*(rho_w*abs(gn)+rho_w)+256td/h), never abs(full g). vn must be zero. True normal flux is -k/gamma*(gradp_x+rho_w*Ace_x)*inward.
budgets.complete_rate: Original upl_cubic_component_r2 raw-sum expression and propagated budget specialized only to constant-k/law=false, with actual conditional C and actual post-wall J/p/Ace. Budget stays64*FLT_EPSILON*raw+256*DBL_EPSILON*max(1,abs(B*theta))+1e-6. No rate-zero claim replaces this comparison.
budgets.negative_nonemptiness: Both host counterfactual fluxes must exceed the SAME good flux budget (>1 ratio), preserving the original GPU small-patch non-vacuity criterion. This is not a claim of the different CPU1280 fixture's >100 ratio witness. No good-state or flux/rate tolerance is widened.

negative_controls.omitted_normal_head: Only boundary pressure is replaced in the host physical-face reconstruction by128+rho_w*gn*mirror_x, the old even-pressure image.
negative_controls.wrong_Ace: Only boundary normal Ace is sign-flipped, representing Q*Ace instead of Q*(Ace+gn)-gn.
negative_controls.zero_normal_g: Both counterfactuals are skipped explicitly; CSV cells are blank and evaluated=0. They are mathematically ineffective for gn=0 and cannot be counted as passed negatives.

overflow_witness.launch: Exactly one extra DynamicPoreWall stage0 kernel; no FS, rate or independent-good reference call for this witness
overflow_witness.expected: Restoring the mirror pressure requires a value outside float range. invalid must identify a real fixed slot0 or1 and preserve its second canary; no input-state write is allowed on rejection.
overflow_witness.counts: One separate expected overflow rejection; excluded from all12 normal-good/ref conditions and negative physical-face counts

execution_contract: Root first full-reads this fresh source/note and the actual production GPU patch. Later build from the authoritative GPU Debug closure and run only if separately authorized. CLI --out FRESH_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY, parent must exist; refuses existing output. No build, run, AST/compiler check, hash or Git operation was performed by this author.
limits: The manufactured GPU patch is81fluid+2fixed, dp=.125, h/dp1.2 and nonperiodic. It differs from the actual CPU1280 initialization/periodic geometry, so no same-ID or cross-backend5Pa/0.005mm equivalence is claimed. Physical-face checks sample one point per wall per condition. Host negative reconstructions are counterfactuals, not additional GPU runs. No full3D/gravity/wall-corner, trajectory, equilibrium or physical release follows.
protected: Only this new C++ and note were authored. Production API/source, old fixtures, evidence, frozen dependencies and paper files remain unchanged.
